title: policy.json: quota
description: Account limits and the owner's reserve (design part 12.5). Autonomous work never spends the reserve. Headroom is the share of a window's limit above the reserve that remains unused.

owner_reserve.description: The share of each limit kept for the owner's own interactive use, unless a limit sets its own reserve (design part 22, Q11).

economize_at.description: Below this headroom: prefer cheaper models and tiers where sizing allows, and lower concurrency.

critical_at.description: Below this headroom: dispatch only critical-path items.

notify_at.description: Shares of a limit used at which a line goes into the digest.

limits.description: The declared limits. A project's list replaces the default list as a whole. The defaults are the two Claude subscription windows, read from status-line snapshots.

forecast_hours.description: How many recent hours the burn rate is smoothed over.

limit.description: One account limit (design part 12.5). Limits whose overrun costs money should be hard (design part 22, Q12). Confidence is derived from source and age, so it is not stored.

window.description: rolling_5h, weekly, monthly_utc, run, or a custom period such as P14D.

limit.description: The amount per window, where known.

scope.description: Which account, harness and models it covers.

hard.description: Exceeding it needs the owner's yes first.

confidence.description: The owner's stated trust in a declared figure. The confidence the system computes from the reading's source and age never exceeds it.
